test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some keys are pens.

All pens are watches.

Conclusions:

(I) Some watches are keys.

(II) All watches are pens.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f9aae116a1f75ab623f4fe5078d53dc6aaa345f6fb9c737a48131a018e2b1a8.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some watches are keys → Follow (As some keys are pens and all pens are watches. As whole pens comes in watches and has some part common with keys, therefore it is true.)

(II) All watches are pens → Does not follow (As all pens are watches. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
